messages:
nina.ops: Heads-up: seeing a sharp rise in 5xx responses for POST /v1/embeddings/bulk_write in eu-west1. Large ingest jobs returning timeouts/503s. Paging SRE and ENG. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2951234567

sre-oncall: Investigating. Metrics show embed-store iops spiking and average write latency hitting ~2s. Error rate ~18% for bulk_write in eu-west1 zone. Starting additional embed-store replicas and checking disk scheduler.

ops-bot: Autoscaling event triggered: scaled embed-store-writer pool from 4 -> 10 in eu-west1-prod.

sam.eng: Checked recent deploys: rolled forward compaction tuning from PR#4903 yesterday. I'm temporarily disabling the aggressive compaction flag: `embed_compact_aggressive=false` and reverting the remote-write batching change for large batches.

sre-oncall: After scale and flag flip, error rate down to ~7%, but occasional spikes remain during large batch windows. Observed I/O stalls on node eu-west1-embed-3: cq_depth=420, io_wait=95%.

luca.cs: Support has the list of customers affected (ingest-heavy accounts). Drafted the customer advisory; holding for one more status check before sending.

sam.eng: Rolling back compaction tuning on eu-west1-prod and putting a short-term admission limiter for batch_size > 1000. Rollback command: `deploy rollback embed-compact-tune 2026-03-23T10:45Z`

sre-oncall: Quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-23T10:41:12Z] embed-writer: bulk_write batch_size=2048 write_ms=2145 err=EIO
[2026-03-23T10:42:03Z] disk-sched: node=eu-west1-embed-3 queue_depth=420 io_wait=95%
```

status-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED by nina.ops -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2951234567 (impact: Partial outage — embedding bulk_write failures in eu-west1; mitigations: scale-up, rollback compaction tuning, batch admission limiter).

nina.ops: Current impact: Hosted API customers performing large embedding bulk writes in eu-west1 may see transient failures. Dedicated/Private unaffected. ETA for next update: 20m or sooner if conditions change.

luca.cs: I'll send the customer advisory now referencing the status page and recommending retry/backoff.

sam.eng: Filed post-incident ticket to add better write admission control and circuit breaker logic: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7310. Postmortem owner: sam.eng. Draft due: EOD tomorrow.

sre-oncall: Moving to monitoring. If you see a regression, tag @sre-oncall. Closing active alert once metrics stabilize. :white_check_mark:
